messages.subject: Access dynamically created textfields
parts:
Hi,

I'm sorry if this questions is already answered but I did not find anything helpful for me yet.

Based on some other R object I would like to have a dynamic number of text inputs for the user (I want the number to depend on the number of topics for a topic model object). The idea let users assign labels for these topics via these text inputs. I already managed to somehow include the correct number of fields:


## server
  output$selectInputs <- renderUI({
    
    w <- ""
    for(i in 1:ncol(props)) { # ncol(props) corresponds to the topics in another R object
      w <- paste(w, textInput(paste("TL", i, sep = ""), paste("Topic ", i, sep = ""), 
                              value = as.character(i)))
    }
    HTML(w)
  })
 ## ui
   htmlOutput("selectInputs")

But I am not able to store the values correctly using them in other outputs. I tried several versions of something like this:

  topiclabels <- reactive({
    topiclabels <- list()
    tlabs <- str_extract_all('^TL', names(input))
    for (i in tlabs) {
      topiclabels$i <- input$i
    }
 
    return(topiclabels)
  })
  
  observe({ # here I would like the choices for another input to be adjusted
  updateSelectInput(session, "topic", choices = topiclabels(),
                    selected=topiclabels()[1])
  })

Can you please give me a hint on how to do this correctly? I'm not sure whether htmlOutput is the correct way in the first place.

Thanks and Cheers
Carsten
